Hi, thanks for flagging this! Two charges in the same month usually happen when your workspace's member count crosses a plan threshold mid-cycle — that triggers a prorated charge for the added members, in addition to your regular monthly renewal charge. Since your two charges ($135 and $27) are for different amounts, this looks like exactly that scenario rather than a duplicate charge.

You can confirm this by going to Settings > Billing > Invoices, where each charge should show as a separate line item explaining what it was for (e.g., renewal vs. proration). If, after checking, you still believe this is an error, please let us know and we'll take a closer look.
